dialogue_inspector.speaker: Inspector
lines: Tickets ready? The hills are waiting beyond the station.
Follow the line carefully, Tenzing. Every stop has a story.

dialogue_boatman.speaker: Boatman
lines: Mirik Lake is quiet when the mist comes down.
The boats move slowly here, but every crossing points back toward the hills.
Walk with the weather, Tenzing. The lake teaches patience before the road climbs again.

dialogue_old_traveler.speaker: Old Traveler
lines: Rohini road rises quietly, one bend after another.
The hills do not hurry. Listen to the wind, watch the banners, and keep your steps steady.
By the time the signpost appears, the mist will already know where you are going.

dialogue_tea_worker.speaker: Tea Worker
lines: The tea gardens wake before the town does.
Darjeeling is best understood one careful step at a time.

dialogue_darjeeling_tea_worker.speaker: Tea Worker
lines: Darjeeling runs on tea, footsteps, and the hum of the hills.
Mall Road stays busy, but the town still moves at mountain pace.
When you watch the gardens and the people together, hill-town life starts to make sense.

dialogue_monk.speaker: Monk
lines: Welcome to Ghoom, the hill of the high peaks. The mist here is the breath of the mountains.
The Maitreya Buddha watches over this pass, waiting for a future where all paths are clear.
As the clouds pass through these halls, remember that even the heaviest fog is only temporary.
Peace is not the absence of the climb, but the steady heart you bring to the trail.

dialogue_monk_stage5.speaker: Monk
lines: Ghoom Monastery has stood since 1850, a silent witness to the clouds and the climbing sun.
We honor the Maitreya Buddha here, the one who is yet to come, the Buddha of Compassion.
The prayer wheels carry our intentions into the wind. Spin them with a kind heart, Tenzing.

dialogue_guide_trail.speaker: Guide
lines: The air is thin here, Tenzing. Take it slow.
Sandakphu is the only place where you can see four of the world's five highest peaks at once.
Look toward the horizon. Even the highest mountains began as a single step.

dialogue_guide_trail_old.speaker: Guide
lines: The Sandakphu trail is beautiful, but it asks for patience.
Keep your breath steady and your eyes on the ridge.

dialogue_guide_summit.speaker: Guide
lines: You made it to the summit.
From here, the clouds are not above you anymore.

lines.speaker: Wise Traveler
lines.text: Look carefully at the mountains. At sunrise, the Kanchenjunga range becomes the Sleeping Buddha.

lines.speaker: Wise Traveler
lines.text: The toy train carried you through the plains and hills, but only your own steps brought you here.

lines.speaker: Wise Traveler
lines.text: Every tea garden, monastery, and winding road below is now part of the view behind you.

lines.speaker: Wise Traveler
lines.text: Before you leave the clouds, reflect on what the journey taught you.

lines.speaker: Mountain Guide
lines.text: From Sandakphu, the Kanchenjunga range looks like a sleeping Buddha resting across the horizon.

lines.speaker: Mountain Guide
lines.text: On clear mornings, travelers wait silently here just to watch the first sunlight touch the snowy peaks.

DIALOG_STAGE_7_SUMMIT.speaker: Wise Traveler
lines: Look out there, Tenzing. The Sleeping Buddha finally reveals itself in the sunrise.
Kanchenjunga doesn't care how fast we climbed. It only cares that we are here to see it.
The toy train brought you part of the way, but your own feet brought you to the clouds.
Every bend in the road, every cup of chai, and every story you heard... they are all part of this view now.
Rest for a moment. The mountains have always been here, and now, they are part of you.

lines.speaker: Monk
lines.text: Welcome to Ghoom Monastery. The prayer wheels carry blessings across the mountains.

lines.speaker: Monk
lines.text: Travelers often stop here to find peace before continuing toward the higher hills.

lines.speaker: Tea Worker
lines.text: The tea gardens of Darjeeling wake before sunrise every morning.

lines.speaker: Tea Worker
lines.text: Travelers often stop here for warm tea before heading uphill.

lines.speaker: Tea Worker
lines.text: Fresh mountain air gives Darjeeling tea its special aroma.

lines.speaker: Tea Worker
lines.text: Many workers here have cared for these gardens for generations.
